capabilities: Rewrite, translate, summarize, and continue selected text or whole notes via streaming AI actions
Fill daily-note template property fields from one quick-log sentence and write weekly AI reviews
Answer questions about the vault with [[links]] and save answers as notes
Auto-tag, summarize into properties, and suggest folders or related-note links
Add Notion-style workflow features: homepage, header buttons, kanban view for Bases, calendar, table formatting
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.10.2+ (Bases view API). The README warns the API key is stored locally in .obsidian/plugins/notewise-ai/data.json and should be excluded from vault sync; selected text and note excerpts are sent to the configured endpoint only when a command is run.
intentEvidence: An AI writing assistant and note manager for Obsidian, inspired by Notion AI.
motivation: The README describes the workflow features as "Notion-style basics, so you need fewer plugins" for desktop and mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI writing or vault-questioning features, and Notion-style workflow conveniences (homepage, kanban, header buttons) require installing several separate plugins.

Works with DeepSeek out of the box and with any OpenAI-compatible API
any OpenAI-compatible API (Qwen, Kimi, OpenAI, Ollama, …)

summary: AI writing assistant and note manager that uses DeepSeek or any OpenAI-compatible API to rewrite, summarize, log, tag, link, and organize notes.
